summary: American women who yearn for more than the boy next door head abroad in search of "real men" with strong values who may be "the one."

name: Besos al Aire
summary: With the most difficult days of confinement as a backdrop, the series narrates eight crossed stories in which a character acts as a common link between them. Javi, a nursing assistant, acts as an intermediary between patients and their families during the coronavirus pandemic. With the desire to soften the trance for both parties, Javi begins to embellish the messages to alleviate those difficult moments, all while longing for a movie love: that of Dr. Cabanas, a distant professional who does not have time to Javier's romanticism.

name: Seven Knights Revolution: Hero Successor
summary: Long ago, Heroes had saved this world. Many Heroes fought against the powers of Destruction and protected the world. Years in the future… The Heroes had disappeared as the years passed and those possessing their powers called Successors now have the fate of the world in their hands. One of the elite Successors known as the Seven Knights is fighting an army of the Destruction when she saves a boy named Nemo. During the battle, Nemo awakens the powers of a Hero even he didn't know about and displays his powers as a Successor. But his Hero is someone who no one knew and no one ever spoke of.

name: Rosie Jones' Trip Hazard
summary: Comedian Rosie Jones takes celebrity friends on thrilling outings around Britain, gorging on culture, learning local traditions and seeking excitement in the unlikeliest of places.

name: De sjældne danskere
summary: Children and young people struggling with diseases that only very few in the world have.

name: Boris Giuliano: Un poliziotto a Palermo
summary: Boris Giuliano returns to his beloved land, Sicily, with the task of occupying the post of police commissioner of the mobile squad. Married to the very young Maria, who has yet to finish her university studies, he certainly does not find a good environment in his homeland: in Palermo, the mafia and good society are one and the same thing. Boris does what is asked of a good policeman, to work against crime with commitment and dedication, and in this courageous task he finds the support of his wife. Everything goes more or less well, until Boris arrests some bosses of the Palermo mafia considered untouchable, who are soon released back into the wild.

name: Dyrevenn
summary: Dyrevenn is the program for those who have or have had pets, and for those who dream of getting one.

name: L'École de la vie
summary: This is the touching story of a teacher in a French suburban school who, after experiencing a personal tragedy, invests himself fully in his teaching and his students. Episodes focuses on difficulties of students, e.g. alcoholism, poverty.

name: Svenska dialektmysterier
summary: Infotainment series looking at the various language dialects around Sweden.

name: QI
summary: QI, or Quite Interesting, is the only comedy quiz where not only the correct, but especially the most interesting and witty answers score points.

name: QI
summary: On the show QI, viewers can look forward to a "Q" as the quality and "I" as information, thanks to the presence of high Qualification intellectuals! QI breaks consistently and interest in myths and assumptions and reveals the unexpected and often shocking information. QI Dim misconceptions about business as topics. QI entertain you and also bring interesting knowledge! QI is a show full of questions, and we all have the answers! The answers are more interesting than the questions! A completely impossible questions, which can not even properly answer? You have absolutely favorite! Therefore, response rate, depending on how they are fun and unexpected, and often have nothing to do with the question. On the other hand, the so-called minus points are strictly punish all the wrong answers are expected, even including all the expected jokes!

name: Brødrene Dal og Mysteriet om Karl XIIs gamasjer
summary: In this series, the Dal brothers must trace the gaiters of Charles XII to avoid Norway having to return to union with Sweden in connection with the 100th anniversary of the dissolution of the union in 2005. The hunt brought them to different eras and historical events in the two countries, including the signing of the union dissolution treaty in Karlstad in 1905, the battle of Dynekilen in 1716 with Tordenskjold, the battle of Fredriksten Fortress in 1718 where Charles XII was killed and the peace negotiations in Kiel 1814.

name: Klass 9A
summary: In Klass 9A, viewers follow a high school class during the fall semester 2007. The class teachers were replaced by "eight of Sweden's foremost educators" (the TV-producer´s words) to help the pupils improve their scores from a low level to a higher level over the course of the semester.

name: Het snelle geld
summary: It is 2012. In the past 25 years, our country has become very rich. And now we are in a crisis that affects us all. What happened? This question brought Jort Kelder and VPRO together. In Het snelle geld, Jort Kelder looks back as an expert witness and involved person on a quarter of a century of wild capitalist years in the Netherlands. In eight episodes, which offer numerous moments of recognition and amazement, Jort Kelder and protagonists shed light on the years 1987 to 2012, a period in which the Netherlands lost its shame for money and wealth and the crisis presented itself.

name: Minute to Win It
summary:
Minute to Win It is a new family-friendly competition series featuring 10 deceptively simple games that require savvy contestants to complete under pressure with a prize of €100.000 awaiting the winner.

Competitors will face 10 challenges that escalate in level of difficulty. Each game has a 60-second time limit and failure to finish the task on time will eliminate the contestant. At various points throughout the game, the contestant can walk away with the money earned up to that point, but it'll take nerves of steel to complete all 10 tasks to win the €100.000.

name: Britains Favourite 80s Songs
summary: A countdown of the nation's favourite 80s songs, year by year.

name: Rich House, Poor House Changed My Life
summary: Revisiting a selection of swaps to see what impact the programme has had on the people featured.
